description: The crypto market's Fear & Greed index (alternative.me), 0 extreme fear to 100 extreme greed, updated once a day: today's value and label, yesterday, a week and a month ago, the 7-day change and the 30-day average. Use to gauge the whole market's mood. Not for one coin's positioning (use get_market_positioning). No inputs. A mood figure, not a signal on its own. Next: get_signal_score.
name: get_fear_and_greed_index

as_of.description: The day the value is for, ISO 8601 UTC

change_7d_points.description: Today minus a week ago, index points

classification.description: The index's own label, e.g. Fear

deprecation.description: Present only while this tool is deprecated: replacement, removal_date, changelog

title: Crypto Fear & Greed index
